Nobody's gonna read this but fuck it.

I really fucked up big time one point last year. It didn't really matter that I was primarily a no commentary streamer. There were a few who still came despite how boring my streams were

I kinda regret I let them all go in the first place, but I don't deserve the time they give to me. I don't deserve anything from being lazy.

Besides, having someone around my streams fucks with my brain. I'm at that point where I'm so fucking used to doing this alone that anything else beyond that just fucks me up. Idk.

I'll keep doing it though. My computer related hobbies like homelabbing is a dead end now cos the hardware prices are fucked up. Looking at the prices makes me wanna kill myself for even liking computers.

Only rich dumb people get the fucking toys ig. Then they flaunt it on their vids how good some piece of hardware/software is to their dumb audiences.

I'm not angry. I'm just.. hungry...

#twitch #youtube #mastodon #homelab #selfhosted #linux
